doc.title: Chronological feed: signed cursor, current batch filtering и refill
doc.summary: Feed возвращает только текущие доступные Published посты в устойчивом chronological order; cursor привязан к контексту и движется по последнему проверенному кандидату.
doc.why: SQL/projection shortlist не является разрешением; фильтрация без refill/last-scanned cursor создаёт пропуски, циклы или privacy leaks.

include: Posts-owned feed query/DTO and internal cursor codec, no separate kernel module/ranker
MAC-bound installation/panel/surface incarnation/filter/order/viewer context and deterministic keyset pagination
Current readMany gating, bounded candidate refill and final body/media/counter output checks

rules: Owner directive 2026-10-29 for P4: exact codex/gpt-6.1-terra (low/medium/high) or codex/gpt-6.1-sol (high/xhigh), as item.route. No substitute gpt-6-terra, gpt-6-astra, Claude/Sonnet writer/reviewer. Actual runtime model/effort/session must be verified, route text is not runtime proof. Unavailable API/model: stop with exact error. Do not alter global execution-policy or accepted P1–P3 routes.

Product execution is future work, not authorized by this design turn. At future execution all declared acceptance checks are required; no pass from a plan, fixture-only substitute, missing consumer/PG, skipped/incomplete/warning/risky tests, timeout or unavailable toolchain. Save command/cwd/exit/stdout/stderr and source fingerprint in this item artifacts only when actually run.

Every PostgreSQL check runs via python3 scripts/testing/pg-run.py; existing PgTarget isolation verifies invocation-owned container/endpoint/run marker/*_test before SQL. Never ambient dev/prod DB or global environment rebuild.

Module code lives under packages/core/modules/{reactions,posts}/src. Kernel never imports social modules; modules never import sibling or foreign Internal classes. Use existing public module/target/schema/operations contracts. Public DTOs contain no ORM. No new generic plugin/transport API or kernel top-level namespace; only already-planned module API and safety/media SPI.

No comments/tree/comment counters, Chatom reaction/Forum vote mirroring, external SQL/FKs, groups implementation, ranking/search/follows, file storage or cross-DB atomicity. Host entity resolution only by trusted TargetResolver; write additionally needs proven TargetWriteFence on owner connection. Remote-only/unprovable fence is denied, never silently accepted.

Current installation/panel/surface/target/incarnation and audience admission precede any allow, including author. Archive/read_only prevents writes. Stable key/digest, CAS, revision, receipt and outbox remain on one owner connection. Never weaken P2 guards to accommodate a module; unexpected contract incompatibility must be made explicit with a failing focused case, not bypassed.

Do not touch foreign .gitignore, .serena/project.yml, CLAUDE.md or outside dirty/untracked; no push/tag/publish/external messages. Do not replay accepted items or widen boundary under a follow-up. Review covers is context, not fan-out; requested reviewer uses fresh read-only SOL session, current candidate receipt, max two rounds with second only for corrected findings/new affected invariant.
doc.guidance:
Feed belongs to posts, optional reactions stays independent: feed DTO returns posts only and host may obtain separately guarded Reactions summaries; posts does not import Reactions to enrich. No new FeedRanker/search/follows/notification pipeline. Sort newest first by immutable first published_at plus id DESC; keyset predicate strictly less than (time,id), no OFFSET. Stable tie timestamps, updates/restores do not reposition; newly published items above cursor appear on refresh, not inserted behind it. Concurrent mutations do not promise a historical snapshot; current policy always wins.
Cursor payload version + key ID + expiry + installation + panel + full SurfaceRef/incarnation + viewer identity/context binding + canonical allowed filters + fixed ordering + last scanned candidate tuple. MAC authenticate canonical bytes with server-managed configured key (never derive secret from public panel ID); verify constant-time before trusting any field. Malformed/oversized/unsupported/expired/unknown key/tampered or cross-panel/surface/viewer/filter cursor is explicit invalid-cursor/problem; never silently restart. Configuration contains only scalar/FQCN values; no secrets in logs/docs/fixtures. Rotation validates only allowed keys until expiry. No raw hidden candidate body/count/target key in cursor; use opaque authenticated encoding if metadata would reveal hidden candidates. Cursor is position, never cached authorization.
Fetch small ordered candidate chunks, read current minimal state then AudienceGate::readMany for exact subjects; denied/missing/error keys, held/hidden/deleted/erased and stale generation excluded before materializing output. Batch grouping includes installation+panel+surface+actor+audience, not contour rank. Refill until requested page size, real exhaustion or explicit bounded scan budget. Cursor advances to last candidate actually evaluated, even if zero allowed, never merely last emitted post or unprocessed fetched tail. On budget exhaustion return fewer/empty items with continuation, do not claim EOF; no rescanning/stall. No totalCount of hidden candidates.
Before emitting body/revision/media refs, compare captured post/privacy/surface generation with current owner state and re-evaluate outside tx if changed, fail closed if unstable; do not call remote policy inside DB tx. Test in-process policy change between shortlist→gate→hydration. Target current sampled-read consistency boundary remains explicit (cannot promise atomic remote revoke). Current MediaResolver access on protected references as required; count fetching cannot bypass P4.3. Final read decisions equal scalar checks and authors cannot bypass revoke.

validation.expect: exit 0; MAC tamper/length/version/expiry/key rotation, full context and canonical filters, deterministic ties and invalid cursor fail closed

exit 0; real PG tie-order, concurrent insert/edit/delete/restore, gaps of denied candidates, empty-page continuation, budget/refill and last-scanned cursor; no duplicates/stalls/dropped eligible candidates

exit 0; stale candidate projections, same-scope shrink/class replacement/direct revoke, changed privacy between gate/hydration, revoked author/archive, scalar==batch and protected media/counts; no hidden totals/IDs
exit 0; all ownership/module/public signature/foreign Internal/runtime guards pass; new module sources included without dropping existing gates
exit 0; no new suppressions/baseline; module sources included
exit 0; adopted Pint rules unchanged; module sources included
